scores.tell: Truss and lamp have tight crisp bevels and thin bars; only slightly chunky lamp yoke.
Dome and base are soft and puffy; the thin dome ribs are thickened; the small tank is toy-like.
Clock ring is a thick tube, but it is a clean simple form. Hands and ticks are thin and crisp.
Rope coils are thick and sausage-like. The simplified loop reads as a game card. The red tie is a bit blobby.
Plate is a thin glass disc with plausible fruit. Fruit is plump and tightly packed, with a slightly crowded silhouette.
Pier posts are thick and soft, the planks are rounded, and the life ring is chunky. Straight runs are slightly wobbly.
Bumper car body is a swollen pillow with no flat planes. The pole is thin but the form is blobby and overly fat.
Target and bear are very rounded and toy-like. The wood shelf and frame have planar faces and straight runs. Many parts crowd the silhouette.
Column has crisp flutes and a flat abacus slab. The volutes are a bit puffy. The sign plate is a bit thick.
Pump body is a fat rounded block with soft corners, but the hose and nozzle are thin. Slab base has straight edges. Part count is good.
